items.prompt: What year? Gareth Bale scored an overhead kick in the Champions League final as Real Madrid beat Liverpool.
items.reveal: Answer: 2018. He came off the bench in Kiev and scored twice.

items.prompt: What year? Eric Cantona launched a kung-fu kick at a fan in the crowd at Selhurst Park.
items.reveal: Answer: 1995. Banned for eight months, then came back and won the Double. Seagulls, trawlers, sardines.

items.prompt: What year? Alan Sunderland slid in a last-minute winner for Arsenal against Manchester United in the FA Cup final.
items.reveal: Answer: 1979. United had come back from 2-0 down to level it. They got about a minute to enjoy it.

items.prompt: What year? Sergio Aguero scored in stoppage time against QPR to win Manchester City the title on goal difference.
items.reveal: Answer: 2012. 93 minutes 20 seconds. "Aguerooooo!" City's first top-flight title for 44 years.

items.prompt: What year? Jimmy Glass, an on-loan goalkeeper, scored in stoppage time to keep Carlisle United in the Football League.
items.reveal: Answer: 1999. Carlisle's keeper went up for a corner, smashed in the rebound, and Scarborough went down instead.

items.prompt: What year? Everton beat Rapid Vienna in Rotterdam to win the European Cup Winners' Cup.
items.reveal: Answer: 1985. They were league champions too. The European ban that followed stopped a tilt at the big one.
